result.instructions: Tools for WorkSchedule.Net, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which users work at the Main location this week?"; "Create an open shift on the Schedule calendar for 9:00 to 17:00 tomorrow at Main."; "Show the time block 49176 and who is assigned to it.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WorkSchedule.Net data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run workschedulenet_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run workschedulenet_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run workschedulenet_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. workschedulenet_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: workschedulenet_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List every user account in the company, with names, UserID, ExternalID, role and department. Use it to find the UserID for a shift. WorkSchedule.Net API: GET /User.

tools.name: workschedulenet_get_user
tools.title: Get user
tools.description: Read one user account by UserID or ExternalID. WorkSchedule.Net API: GET /User/{id}, Lookup-Key header.

id.description: The id value, matching the lookup key.

lookup_key.description: Which id the value is: UserID (default) or ExternalID.

tools.name: workschedulenet_list_category_items
tools.title: List category items
tools.description: List every item in one category, such as Locations, Areas or Departments, with CatItemID. Use the IDs in shift CategoryItems. WorkSchedule.Net API: GET /CategoryItem/{CatName}.

category.description: Category name, for example Location, Area, Department or Tasks.

tools.name: workschedulenet_get_category_item
tools.title: Get category item
tools.description: Read one category item by CatItemID or ExternalID. WorkSchedule.Net API: GET /CategoryItem/{CatName}/{id}, Lookup-Key header.

category.description: Category name, for example Location, Area, Department or Tasks.

id.description: The id value, matching the lookup key.

lookup_key.description: Which id the value is: CatItemID (default) or ExternalID.

tools.name: workschedulenet_get_timeblock
tools.title: Get time block
tools.description: Read one shift or time-off block by TimeBlockID or ExternalID, from the Schedule or Attendance calendar. WorkSchedule.Net API: GET /TimeBlock/{calendar}/{id}.

calendar.description: Schedule for shifts, Attendance for time-off and attendance blocks.

id.description: The id value, matching the lookup key.

lookup_key.description: Which id the value is: TimeBlockID (default) or ExternalID.

tools.name: workschedulenet_create_timeblock
tools.title: Create time block
tools.description: Create a shift or time-off block for a user, or an open shift with user_id "0". This writes to the live schedule. WorkSchedule.Net API: POST /TimeBlock/{calendar}.

calendar.description: Schedule for shifts, Attendance for time-off and attendance blocks.

user_id.description: UserID of the assigned user, or 0 for an open shift.

start_time.description: ISO-8601 local time, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00. The API reads it in the API user's default time zone.

end_time.description: ISO-8601 local time, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00. The API reads it in the API user's default time zone.

notes.description: Free-text notes on the time block.

external_id.description: Your own id for this record in another system.

category_items.description: Map of category name to Category Item ID, for example {"Location": "1", "Area": "11"}.

tools.name: workschedulenet_update_timeblock
tools.title: Update time block
tools.description: Change one shift or time-off block: user, times, notes, colour, external id or category items. Send only the fields to change. This writes to the live schedule. WorkSchedule.Net API: PUT /TimeBlock/{calendar}/{id}.

calendar.description: Schedule for shifts, Attendance for time-off and attendance blocks.

id.description: The id value, matching the lookup key.

lookup_key.description: Which id the value is: TimeBlockID (default) or ExternalID.

user_id.description: New UserID, or 0 for an open shift.

start_time.description: ISO-8601 local time, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00. The API reads it in the API user's default time zone.

end_time.description: ISO-8601 local time, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00. The API reads it in the API user's default time zone.

notes.description: Free-text notes on the time block.

external_id.description: Your own id for this record in another system.

category_items.description: Map of category name to Category Item ID, for example {"Location": "1", "Area": "11"}.
